title: Study in Malaysia
tagline: English-taught programs, branch campuses of UK and Australian universities, affordable living costs.
intro:
Malaysia offers an English-taught education and an internationally recognised degree for less than the UK or Australia. Foreign university campuses and strong local universities operate here, with several intakes a year.

We choose the program and handle admission and your Student Pass.
services: Advice on housing and living costs

sections.heading: Why Malaysia
sections.body:
- Fully **English-taught** programs.
- **Foreign university campuses** — a degree from the home university.
- Several **intakes a year** — no need to wait for September.
- Affordable **cost of living** and a pleasant climate.
- A convenient base for travelling around Asia.

sections.heading: Foundation
sections.body: School graduates from Kyrgyzstan usually start with a **Foundation** program (about one year) and then enter the first year of a bachelor’s degree.

documents: Passport (valid for the full study period plus margin)
IELTS/TOEFL (some programs accept an internal test)
Medical check — as required by EMGS
Proof of funds (if required by the university)

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We choose a program and the nearest intake.

steps.title: Application
steps.text: We submit documents and obtain the offer letter.

steps.title: Student Pass
steps.text: We process the pass through EMGS.

steps.title: Departure
steps.text: We prepare you for the flight and your first days.

faq.q: Is a branch campus degree recognised?
faq.a: Foreign university campuses usually award the home university’s degree. We confirm this for each specific program.
Most programs require IELTS or TOEFL, but some universities accept their own test or offer English preparation.
Many universities have several intakes a year, so you can start without a long wait.
